name: twc-skills
description: A growing collection of Claude skills for producing academic work at IEEE Transactions / communications journal standard. Covers scientific figures (twc-figure), manuscript prose polishing (twc-polishing), citation retrieval and export (twc-citation), data availability statements and FAIR metadata (twc-data), and paper-to-PPTX presentation conversion (twc-paper2ppt). Adapted from nature-skills (Yuan1z0825) and tailored for IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications and related venues. All rules derived from primary sources — published IEEE papers, journal author guidelines, and structured writing curricula.
